objective: Build MapLibre fill and border source data from revisioned WorldStateV2 projection artifacts while preserving unaffected territory feature references.
notes: The synchronized map source adapter now applies WorldPatchV2 territory deltas instead of recreating every source feature; it also detects geometry or ownership differences so incomplete delta metadata cannot leave stale source data.

GameSetupShell passes the previously rendered map artifact to the next WorldStateV2 projection. Both low- and high-resolution fill collections reuse unchanged feature objects, and unchanged canonical border features are reused.
Source-level appliedRevision advances for every committed state; an unchanged feature retains its original projectionRevision as its feature creation revision so object identity remains stable.
WorldMap already consumes the resulting projection as GeoJSON and owns the MapLibre objects; no MapLibre instance is introduced into projection/domain code.

The full browser E2E suite was not rerun for this recovered stage. The full unit suite, typecheck, lint, and production build passed. The build still reports the pre-existing dynamic seed filesystem tracing warning.
